readmeExcerpt:
# **omi** ### A 2nd brain you trust more than your 1st Omi captures your screen and conversations, transcribes in real-time, generates summaries and action items, and gives you an AI chat that remembers everything you've seen and heard. Works on desktop, phone and wearables. Fully open source. Trusted by 300,000+ professionals.     [Website](https://omi.me/) · [Docs](https://docs.omi.me/) · [Discord](http://discord.omi.me) · [Twitter](https://x.com/kodjima33) · [DeepWiki](https://deepwiki.com/BasedHardware/omi)
## Quick Start ### macOS ```sh git clone https://github.com/BasedHardware/omi.git && cd omi/desktop/macos && ./run.sh --yolo ``` Builds the macOS app, connects to the cloud backend, and launches. No env files, no credentials, no local backend. > **Requirements:** macOS 14+, [Xcode](https://developer.apple.com/xcode/) (includes Swift & code signing), [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) ### Windows ```powershell git clone https://github.com/BasedHardware/omi.git cd omi\desktop\windows npm install copy .env.example .env npm run dev ``` Starts the Windows desktop app from source using the public config in `.env.example`. > **Requirements:** [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) For development worktrees, run the baseline local setup once. It installs the Git hooks and syncs the pinned backend Python environment used by selected pre-push checks; mobile and desktop runtime environments remain opt-in. ```bash make setup ```
Full Installation For local development with the full backend stack: 1. Install prerequisites ```bash xcode-select --install uv --version ``` 2. Clone and configure ```bash git clone https://github.com/BasedHardware/omi.git cd omi/desktop/macos cp ../../backend/.env.example ../../backend/.env ``` 3. Build and run ```bash ./run.sh ``` See [desktop/macos/README.md](desktop/macos/README.md) for environment variables and credential setup. ### Mobile App ```bash cd app && bash setup.sh ios # or: bash setup.sh android ```

Try in Browser

readmeHtml:
omi

A 2nd brain you trust more than your 1st

Omi captures your screen and conversations, transcribes in real-time, generates summaries and action items, and gives you an AI chat that remembers everything you've seen and heard. Works on desktop, phone and wearables. Fully open source.

Trusted by 300,000+ professionals.

   

Website · Docs · Discord · Twitter · DeepWiki

Quick Start

macOS

git clone https://github.com/BasedHardware/omi.git && cd omi/desktop/macos && ./run.sh --yolo

Builds the macOS app, connects to the cloud backend, and launches. No env files, no credentials, no local backend.

Requirements: macOS 14+, Xcode (includes Swift & code signing), Node.js

Windows

git clone https://github.com/BasedHardware/omi.git
cd omi\desktop\windows
npm install
copy .env.example .env
npm run dev

Starts the Windows desktop app from source using the public config in .env.example.

Requirements: Node.js

For development worktrees, run the baseline local setup once. It installs the Git hooks and syncs the pinned backend Python environment used by selected pre-push checks; mobile and desktop runtime environments remain opt-in.

make setup
Full Installation

For local development with the full backend stack:

  1. Install prerequisites
xcode-select --install
uv --version
  1. Clone and configure
git clone https://github.com/BasedHardware/omi.git
cd omi/desktop/macos
cp ../../backend/.env.example ../../backend/.env
  1. Build and run
./run.sh

See desktop/macos/README.md for environment variables and credential setup.

Mobile App

cd app && bash setup.sh ios    # or: bash setup.sh android

Try in Browser

aiSummary.oneLiner: An open-source wearable AI platform that captures and analyzes your daily interactions.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Omi is a comprehensive software platform designed for wearable AI devices that function as a secondary brain. It continuously captures audio conversations and screen data, performing real-time transcription and analysis. The system autonomously generates contextual summaries, extracts actionable items, and logs them into a searchable database. It provides an intelligent chat interface allowing users to query their past experiences and interactions seamlessly. The architecture spans across mobile applications, wearables, and desktop environments to ensure ubiquitous personal data capture.
keyFeatures: Real-time transcription: Converts continuous ambient audio into accurate text instantly.
Contextual memory: Stores interactions in a searchable format, allowing the AI to recall past events.
Action item extraction: Autonomously identifies and highlights tasks or commitments from daily conversations.
Multi-device ecosystem: Synchronizes data seamlessly across custom wearables, mobile apps, and desktop clients.
Proactive assistance: Provides an AI chat interface that actively utilizes your personal historical context.

useCases.title: Personal life logging
useCases.description: Individuals wanting a complete, searchable archive of their daily conversations and decisions.

useCases.title: Meeting summarization
useCases.description: Professionals automatically capturing action items from spontaneous, unrecorded discussions.

useCases.title: Accessibility augmentation
useCases.description: Users with memory impairments leveraging the device to recall specific details and commitments.

useCases.title: Context-aware AI assistance
useCases.description: Tech enthusiasts interacting with an LLM that inherently understands their recent life events.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Aimed at quantified-self enthusiasts, hardware hackers, and professionals seeking extreme productivity. It is suitable for those comfortable deploying complex mobile and hardware-linked software stacks.
